tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE "auth_group" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" varchar(150) NOT NULL UNIQUE)

CREATE TABLE "auth_group_permissions" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "group_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_group" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "permission_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_permission" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "auth_permission" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "content_type_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "django_content_type" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "codename" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "auth_user" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "password" varchar(128) NOT NULL, "last_login" datetime NULL, "is_superuser" bool NOT NULL, "username" varchar(150) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "last_name" varchar(150) NOT NULL, "email" varchar(254) NOT NULL, "is_staff" bool NOT NULL, "is_active" bool NOT NULL, "date_joined" datetime NOT NULL, "first_name" varchar(150) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "auth_user_groups" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "user_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "group_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_group" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "auth_user_user_permissions" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "user_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "permission_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_permission" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "core_assessment" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "max_score" decimal NOT NULL, "course_grade_weight" decimal NOT NULL, "offering_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "core_courseoffering" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "positive_assessment_max_score" CHECK ("max_score" > '0'))

CREATE TABLE "core_assessmentlomapping" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "weight" decimal NOT NULL, "assessment_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "core_assessment" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "learning_outcome_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "core_learningoutcome" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "unique_assessment_lo_mapping" UNIQUE ("assessment_id", "learning_outcome_id"), CONSTRAINT "positive_assessment_lo_weight" CHECK ("weight" > '0'))
CREATE TABLE "core_course" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "code" varchar(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "title" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "credits" decimal NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "core_coursecurriculum" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "version_number" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("version_number" >= 0), "status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "course_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "core_course" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "unique_course_curriculum_version" UNIQUE ("course_id", "version_number"))

CREATE TABLE "core_courseoffering" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "year" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("year" >= 0), "term" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "section" varchar(10) NOT NULL, "status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "course_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "core_course" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "curriculum_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "core_coursecurriculum" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "instructor_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "core_instructor" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "po_framework_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "core_poframework" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "unique_course_offering" UNIQUE ("course_id", "year", "term", "section"))

CREATE TABLE "core_coursepocontribution" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "weight" smallint unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("weight" >= 0), "curriculum_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "core_coursecurriculum" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "program_outcome_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "core_programoutcome" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "unique_course_po_contribution" UNIQUE ("curriculum_id", "program_outcome_id"), CONSTRAINT "course_po_weight_between_1_and_5" CHECK (("weight" >= 1 AND "weight" <= 5)))

CREATE TABLE "core_enrollment" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "offering_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "core_courseoffering" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "student_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "core_student" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "unique_student_enrollment" UNIQUE ("student_id", "offering_id"))

CREATE TABLE "core_grade" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "score" decimal NULL, "assessment_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "core_assessment" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "enrollment_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "core_enrollment" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "unique_enrollment_assessment_grade" UNIQUE ("enrollment_id", "assessment_id"))
CREATE TABLE "core_instructor" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "full_name" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "email" varchar(254) NOT NULL UNIQUE)

CREATE TABLE "core_learningoutcome" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "code" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "description" text NOT NULL, "curriculum_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "core_coursecurriculum" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "unique_learning_outcome_per_curriculum" UNIQUE ("curriculum_id", "code"))

CREATE TABLE "core_lopomapping" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "strength" smallint unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("strength" >= 0), "learning_outcome_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "core_learningoutcome" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "program_outcome_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "core_programoutcome" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "unique_lo_po_mapping" UNIQUE ("learning_outcome_id", "program_outcome_id"), CONSTRAINT "lo_po_strength_between_1_and_5" CHECK (("strength" >= 1 AND "strength" <= 5)))

CREATE TABLE "core_poframework" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "version_number" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("version_number" >= 0), "status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "program_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "core_program" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "unique_program_po_framework_version" UNIQUE ("program_id", "version_number"))
CREATE TABLE "core_program" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "code" varchar(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" varchar(200) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "core_programoutcome" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "code" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "description" text NOT NULL, "framework_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "core_poframework" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "unique_program_outcome_code_per_framework" UNIQUE ("framework_id", "code"))

CREATE TABLE "core_student" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "student_number" varchar(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "full_name" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "program_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "core_program" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "django_admin_log" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "object_id" text NULL, "object_repr" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "action_flag" smallint unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("action_flag" >= 0), "change_message" text NOT NULL, "content_type_id" integer NULL REFERENCES "django_content_type" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "user_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "action_time" datetime NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE "django_content_type" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "app_label" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "model" varchar(100) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE "django_migrations" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "app" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "applied" datetime NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE "django_session" ("session_key" varchar(40) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "session_data" text NOT NULL, "expire_date" datetime NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)
